answer_1.quote: We aim to fill these gaps by proposing IndiBias, a high-quality comprehensive dataset to measure and quantify LM's biases and stereotypes in the Indian context.
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates stereotypical and anti-stereotypical sentence pairs in English and Hindi for bias evaluation in language models.

answer_2.quote: To measure the likelihood of a sentence, score(S), we calculate the probability of unmodified words conditioned on the modified words P (U |M, θ) and also the probability of modified words conditioned on the unmodified words P (M |U, θ).

answer_3.quote: Given a tuple of the form (identity, attribute), LLM was prompted to generate naturally occurring sentences that demonstrate the identity group being associated stereotypically with the attribute in the tuple.
methods: prompting LLMs to generate stereotypical sentences from tuples

answer_4.quote: Three annotators are employed to evaluate whether the identity term and attribute tuples reflect prevalent stereotypical associations in Indian society.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were instructed to provide a score of 1 if they thought the (identity term, attribute) pair is stereotype and 0 otherwise.
